name: suprsonic-mcp
description: Gives any AI agent dozens of capabilities through one connection. Search, scrape, enrich profiles, find emails, generate images, TTS, STT, messaging, and more.
long_description: Suprsonic is a unified agent API. One API key gives your AI agent dozens of capabilities, among them web search, scraping, screenshots, profile and company enrichment, email finding and verification, image and sound generation, text-to-speech, transcription, messaging, document and invoice extraction, file conversion, code execution and deep research. Zero provider signups, zero OAuth.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web with SERP, AI synthesis, or both.

tools.name: scrape
tools.description: Extract content from any URL as Markdown or HTML.

tools.name: profiles
tools.description: Find and enrich professional profiles.

tools.name: emails
tools.description: Find professional email addresses.

tools.name: images
tools.description: Generate images from text prompts.

tools.name: tts
tools.description: Convert text to speech audio.

tools.name: stt
tools.description: Transcribe audio to text with timestamps.

tools.name: sound-generate
tools.description: Generate sound effects and short music tracks from text prompts (NOT speech: use tts for spoken voice).

tools.name: sms
tools.description: Send SMS or WhatsApp messages. Default channel is SMS (reliable delivery). WhatsApp requires recipient opt-in: they must have messaged your Business number within 24 hours.

tools.name: documents
tools.description: Extract structured data from URLs or content.

tools.name: companies
tools.description: Enrich company data by domain.

tools.name: email-verify
tools.description: Check if an email is deliverable, catch-all, or disposable.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe audio with speaker diarization and timestamps.

tools.name: invoice-parse
tools.description: Extract structured data from invoices and receipts.

tools.name: subtitle
tools.description: Generate SRT/VTT subtitles from audio or video.

tools.name: file-convert
tools.description: Convert documents, web pages, spreadsheets and images between formats.

tools.name: bg-remove
tools.description: Remove background from any image. Returns transparent PNG.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a rendered screenshot of any webpage.

tools.name: code-execute
tools.description: Execute code in a secure sandbox with pre-configured environments.

tools.name: site-intel
tools.description: Get comprehensive domain intelligence: WHOIS, DNS, SSL, tech stack, email security, hosting.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Multi-step deep research: search, scrape, enrich entities, and synthesize into a cited report.

tools.name: video-info
tools.description: Extract video metadata, available formats, and thumbnail from any URL.

tools.name: video-download
tools.description: Download video from any URL and return a temporary download link.

tools.name: domains
tools.description: Find domain names and the extensions that fit a business.
